document.author: lead-partner
document.stage: 3 of 3 — FINAL: costed recommendation and rollout plan (lead-partner)
document.title: Brightline CRM Evaluation — Final Recommendation

final_recommendation.author: lead-partner
final_recommendation.decision: HubSpot (Sales Hub Professional + Marketing Hub Professional), 40 seats, EU (Frankfurt) data residency selected at portal creation

year_1_cost_breakdown_eur.note: List pricing at Jan-2026 knowledge cutoff, EUR, annual billing, ex-VAT. Marketing Hub taken at upper-mid contact tier given agency prospect-list behaviour (risk-analyst sev-4 finding). Reverse-ETL line is a decision-gated contingency, only if DSP audience sync is required.

final_recommendation.savings_lever: Seat-mix optimisation: 20-25 full seats + free/light seats could cut the Sales Hub line by EUR 13-18k/yr; model kept at 40 full seats for conservatism.

comparison_rejected.salesforce_year_1_eur: ~104000+ (plus admin/partner retainer EUR 10-25k/yr; realistic 3-yr TCO 1.5-2x headline)
comparison_rejected.zoho_year_1_eur: ~26000 headline + EUR 5-10k/yr middleware glue + support self-reliance + heavier GDPR diligence

non_negotiable_contract_terms: EU (Frankfurt) data residency specified in the order form and verified before any data import — cannot be relocated later
Written marketing-contact tier pricing schedule appended to the order form
Renewal uplift cap (CPI or fixed %) and calendared renewal notice window
Pre-contract verification of all Jan-2026 list prices against live vendor quotes (mandatory gate)

rollout_plan.name: Verify & Contract
rollout_plan.actions: Price-verification gate (closes the sev-3 all-vendor pricing risk); negotiate the four non-negotiable terms; DPA + sub-processor review; create portal with EU residency and confirm region in writing before any import.

rollout_plan.name: Migrate & Adopt
rollout_plan.actions: Guided import (mark non-marketing contacts at import to pre-empt tier creep); pipeline + retainer/campaign object configuration on Pro tier; role-based training for all 40 staff; appoint named internal CRM owner; adoption KPI: >70% weekly active usage by week 9.

rollout_plan.name: Ad-Ops Activation & Scale
rollout_plan.actions: Connect native Ads tool (Meta/Google/LinkedIn) with CRM-audience sync and ROI attribution; GA4 event export; decision gate on reverse-ETL (Hightouch/Census, EUR 3-6k/yr) for DSP audiences; quarterly list-hygiene routine; month-6 review of Enterprise-tier delta against actual reporting needs.

final_recommendation.specialist_weighing: Ranking HubSpot > Zoho > Salesforce adopted as confirmed by both specialists. Where stage 1 and stage 2 pulled apart: (1) Zoho's cost case (stage 1) discounted because stage 2's recurring taxes — middleware glue, support self-reliance, SCC-only India-parent transfers — erode roughly half the saving and put a sev-4 fragility on the agency's core Meta workflow; (2) Salesforce's capability depth (stage 1) outweighed by stage 2's highest composite risk (adoption 4, cost-creep 4, lock-in 3) for capability Brightline does not yet need; (3) stage 1's ~EUR 66k HubSpot year-1 chart revised up to ~EUR 70k by taking the upper-mid marketing-contact tier, crediting the risk-analyst's sev-4 tier-creep finding over the researcher's midpoint.
